Nearly invisible ducts in your skin secrete a layer of slime that coats your flesh.

Activate—Secrete Slime 1 (concentrate)

Requirements You activate the ducts, covering yourself with a thin layer of slime

Effect The black, tar-like sludge on your skin sticks to anything that touches it. The green-tinged oil coating your skin is radioactive. This radiation is harmless to you and other creatures, but its emanations interfere with teleportation magic. You gain a +2 item bonus to saving throws against effects that would teleport you. In addition, a creature that teleports to within 30 feet of you is thrown off by the interference, taking a –2 circumstance penalty to all checks and DCs until the beginning of their next turn. The slime lasts for 10 minutes or until you Dismiss the effect.
